placeholders.{ROOM}: the room given to summon (a chat room: its roster carries Hermes's stream)
placeholders.{FOUNDER}: the summoner, who must be the room's founder
placeholders.{H}: Hermes's subject (the node's Hermes, HOME/hermes/node.json, or --hermes)

docs.name: {ROOM}-index
docs.law: any [ not (verb == write), all [ any [ subject == {FOUNDER}, subject == {H} ], slot "content/atom-edits" == 0, slot "content/tombstones" == 0 ] ]

docs.name: {ROOM}-digest
docs.law: any [ not (verb == write), all [ any [ subject == {FOUNDER}, subject == {H} ], slot "content/atom-edits" == 0, slot "content/tombstones" == 0 ] ]
